description: issue #684 (slice I5): the multiline `on_key "space" ... end on_key` form behaves identically to the bracket form — it registers one keyboard handler and emits the `instruction`+`primitive` pair (seq 0-1) after registration (spec/interaction-events.md's event-block-tail grammar and "Event registration forms emit `primitive` events after the handler is registered"). No key is delivered in a headless run, so the body never fires.
